purpose: Teach: 伴わ/望め/不運/奨め/ドンドン/浮かび上がっ/不機嫌/塗る

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが伴わずにお出かけは禁止よ
lines.en: Sho, you can't go out without your father. Understood?
lines.style: Firm but maternal. Light, expectant pause after the name. Clear rule-statement with a soft uptick at the end—checking he's listening, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、テストで百点を望めるよう頑張るね
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to work really hard so I do well on my test!
lines.style: Bright, earnest rush of words. Opening attack on the first word—eager to share. Breathless optimism. Small boy's determination without self-doubt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達の不運な出来事に寄り添ってあげましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's be kind to your friend when they're having a hard time, okay?
lines.style: Gentle teaching voice. Warm and steady. Slight pause before 'hard time'—making space for him to understand. Inviting his kindness, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが新しいゲームを奨めて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad recommended a new game and he gave it to me!
lines.style: Quick, bright surprise at the start. Wide-eyed excitement in the middle words. Small laugh-lift on 'gave it to me.' Natural kid enthusiasm, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ドンドン階段を昇るのは危ないわよ
lines.en: Sho, don't stomp up the stairs like that. You could get hurt.
lines.style: Alert, quick-response concern. No anger, but immediate. Slight edge on 'stomp'—catching the behavior mid-motion. Soft landing on the reason why.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お風呂で気持ちが浮かび上がってきたよ
lines.en: Mom, I felt something light and happy come up in me during my bath!
lines.style: Wondering, slightly dreamy. Opening soft and slow. Pauses between phrases like he's looking for the right words. Genuine small-boy discovery, not performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが今日は不機嫌そうだから静かにしようね
lines.en: Sho, your father seems to be in a bad mood today, so let's be quiet, alright?
lines.style: Lowered volume, conspiratorial tone. Gentle warning shared between them—us-and-him feeling. Calm and practical, not alarming. Slight trailing-off after 'alright.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと一緒に絵に色を塗るのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I love painting pictures with Dad. We do it together.
lines.style: Soft, contented voice. Opening with genuine warmth. Slight pause after 'Dad'—he's picturing it. Trailing off gently on the last words, like the memory is still warm in his hands.
